title: PowerPoint: clearer on-screen presenting controls for single-screen Slide Show
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts match the supplied roadmap record, and its licensing and general policy statements match Microsoft Learn. Searches confirmed the feature-specific documentation gaps as of November 27, 2026. One descriptive statement should be narrowed: the sources do not establish that a person triggers every action.
